title: Jesus warned that the last days would be marked by deception, conflict, and hearts growing cold.
paragraphs: Jesus warned that the last days would be marked by deception, conflict, and hearts growing cold.

What we’re witnessing isn’t random chaos.
It’s prophecy unfolding.
The darkness rising in the world was written thousands of years ago.

But the Bible also gives hope:
The Gospel is still saving lives.
Are you ready for His return?
Have you noticed how fast things are changing?

Wars. Division. Truth being mocked.
People becoming colder.
Jesus literally said this would happen.
The darker the world gets, the more the Bible proves true.

When you look at the world today…
does it feel like prophecy unfolding?
